title: Attention-Enhanced Dual-Branch ConvNeXt-BiLSTM Network for Subject-Independent EEG Seizure Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.22141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated seizure detection from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is difficult because seizure morphology varies among patients and seizure samples are substantially outnumbered by non-seizure samples. This paper presents an attention-enhanced dual-branch network that jointly learns time--frequency and temporal representations from the same EEG segment. A continuous wavelet transform converts each segment into a scalogram processed by an ImageNet-pretrained ConvNeXt-Tiny backbone and squeeze-and-excitation attention. In parallel, a bidirectional long short-term memory network followed by multi-head self-attention models the raw signal. The two feature vectors are concatenated and classified by a weighted multilayer perceptron. Experiments use 14 subjects from the CHB-MIT scalp EEG database with subject-wise partitioning performed before overlapping segmentation. The model obtains $97.88\%$ accuracy and $97.51\%$ F1-score over ten acr

translated_title: 注意力增强的双分支ConvNeXt-BiLSTM网络用于受试者无关的脑电癫痫发作检测
translated_abstract: 从头皮脑电图中自动检测癫痫发作十分困难，因为癫痫发作的形态在不同患者之间差异很大，且癫痫发作样本数量远少于非发作样本。本文提出了一种注意力增强的双分支网络，可从同一段脑电信号中联合学习时频表示和时间表示。通过连续小波变换将每个片段转换为尺度图，再由ImageNet预训练的ConvNeXt-Tiny骨干网络和压缩-激励注意力进行处理。与此同时，双向长短期记忆网络结合多头自注意力机制对原始信号进行建模。两个特征向量被拼接后由加权多层感知机进行分类。实验使用CHB-MIT头皮脑电数据库中的14名受试者，并在重叠分段之前按受试者进行数据划分。该模型获得了97.88%的准确率和97.51%的F1分数（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种注意力增强的双分支ConvNeXt-BiLSTM网络，联合学习脑电信号的时频特征与时间特征，实现了受试者无关的癫痫发作检测，准确率达97.88%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an attention-enhanced dual-branch ConvNeXt-BiLSTM network that jointly learns time-frequency and temporal EEG representations, achieving 97.88% accuracy for subject-independent seizure detection.
